info.title: TraceQ
info.summary: Run folders read-only; Proposals in the database, behind a token.

get.description: The traceability matrix: Coverage class and reason, and cited Evidence.
The Pre-review: Check Findings, AI Findings kept apart, and missing documents.
The claims the citation check dropped, each with its subject and reason.
The URS completeness check; not found for a run written before it existed.
A document the run read, as released: a citation links here with ``#page=N``.

post.description:
Imports a run folder as Proposals, in one transaction. Importing a run already
imported changes nothing. Needs the deciding role.

get.description:
The Proposals of an imported run, in the order of its files, with their decision
state and decisions.

The Protocol Draft a Review Package run read: its Test Steps in draft order, its
traceability rows and its findings, each with its decision state once the run is
imported. Any role may read it; deciding goes through ``recordDecision``.

post.description:
Records one Proposal Decision on the content this run proposed, with its Audit
Trail entry. Earlier decisions stay. Needs the deciding role.

get.description: Per kind of Proposal of an imported run: how many there are and where they stand.

post.description:
Starts the Protocol of the run's Equipment from this imported run, in Draft status,
with its Audit Trail entry. Refused (409) while a Protocol of the Equipment is open
(Draft or Submitted), once one is approved, and for a run whose folder has
``drafts.json`` but which holds no drafted Test Step Proposals. Needs the deciding
role.

get.description:
The Protocol most recently started from this run: its status and every status
change, and in Draft status its rows computed from the current decisions. Any
signed-in role may read it.

post.description:
Withdraws a Protocol in Draft status, with a reason and its Audit Trail entry, so
a new Protocol of the Equipment can be started. Needs the deciding role.

AiFinding.title: AiFinding
AiFinding.description: A Pre-review finding of the LLM, every citation verified; advisory (ADR 0002).

AmbiguousValue.title: AmbiguousValue
AmbiguousValue.description: An observation that reads two ways: ask for confirmation, never guess.

CheckFinding.title: CheckFinding
CheckFinding.description: A Pre-review finding of a deterministic rule: no model involved.

Cite.title: Cite
Cite.description: Where a claim comes from: document, revision, page and the verbatim quote.

Completeness.title: Completeness
Completeness.description:
The URS completeness check of a run: printed numbers that did not become a
requirement, and URS text no kept requirement quotes.

Decision.title: Decision
Decision.description: A recorded Proposal Decision: what, who, when and why.

DecisionCounts.title: DecisionCounts
DecisionCounts.description:
Stored decisions counted per kind of Proposal for one run. Counts, not a measure of
quality.

DesignRow.title: DesignRow
DesignRow.description: A datasheet or certificate value compared with the URS value.

DraftAcceptance.title: DraftAcceptance
DraftAcceptance.description:
A Test Step's Acceptance Criterion as printed, the value code read from it (none: a
form the parser does not know) and the verified citation it was read from.

DraftCheckFinding.title: DraftCheckFinding
DraftCheckFinding.description:
A Check Finding (layer Rule) on the draft, with the values it compared, as parsed. It
is on a Test Step (``test_step``) or, for ``requirement_not_tested``, on a traceability
row (``row``, the row's requirement id).

DraftComparator.title: DraftComparator
DraftComparator.description:
The vendor facts of one document a requirement's matrix row holds: shown only, never
a finding.

DraftDocument.title: DraftDocument
DraftDocument.description: The Protocol Draft under review: document, revision and the SHA-256 of its bytes.

DraftFindingView.title: DraftFindingView
DraftFindingView.description: A finding on the Protocol Draft and the Proposal it was imported as.

DraftTestStep.title: DraftTestStep
DraftTestStep.description:
A Test Step of the draft, in draft order, as read and compared, or not read: the draft
prints it, but the citation check dropped its reading (``not_read``).

DraftTraceRow.title: DraftTraceRow
DraftTraceRow.description: A row of the draft's traceability table: a requirement and its Test Step ids.

DraftTraced.title: DraftTraced
DraftTraced.description: A Test Step's AC compared with one requirement the traceability table traces it to.

DraftedTestStep.title: DraftedTestStep
DraftedTestStep.description:
An IQ/OQ Test Step the run drafted for a requirement, an AI Finding a human decides
(written by ``traceq.runs.drafts``). Not a Test Step of a site Protocol Draft
(``DraftTestStep``). The AC is present only when copied from a verified citation;
otherwise ``acceptance_flag`` says why it is "to be set by a human".

DroppedClaim.title: DroppedClaim
DroppedClaim.description: A claim the citation check dropped, with its reason in plain text.

EvidenceStep.title: EvidenceStep
EvidenceStep.description: A vendor FAT/SAT step linked to a requirement, with its verdict.

Findings.title: Findings
Findings.description:
The Pre-review of a run: Check Findings and AI Findings kept apart, and the
documents the VMP requires that the corpus lacks.

GoverningDocument.title: GoverningDocument
GoverningDocument.description: A VMP or SOP the run read its required documents and site rules from.

KindCounts.title: KindCounts
KindCounts.description:
The Proposals of one kind in a run, by decision state. ``total`` is the sum of
``undecided``, ``changed`` and the current decisions ``accepted``, ``edited`` and
``rejected``.

Limit.title: Limit
Limit.description: A limit as printed: either bound may be strict (``< 0,8 µm``).

Matrix.title: Matrix
Matrix.description: The traceability matrix of a run.

MatrixRow.title: MatrixRow
MatrixRow.description: One requirement: its text and value, Coverage class and reason, and Evidence.

MissedNumber.title: MissedNumber
MissedNumber.description: A printed requirement number that did not become a kept requirement.

MissingDocument.title: MissingDocument
MissingDocument.description: A document the VMP requires that the corpus lacks.

NewDecision.title: NewDecision
NewDecision.description:
A Proposal Decision on the content the run proposed.

A Check Finding, AI Finding or drafted Test Step is ``accepted`` or ``rejected``; a
Coverage row is ``accepted`` or ``edited`` to another class (only ``edited`` when the
system proposed no class). A Reason for Change is required for ``rejected`` and
``edited``, and for any decision that replaces an earlier one on the same content.

NotRead.title: NotRead
NotRead.description: A vendor document the run could not read.

Present.title: Present
Present.description: A feature that must exist; ``value`` is set when an observation states it.

Proposal.title: Proposal
Proposal.description: A Proposal of a run, where it stands in the run's files, and its decision state.

ProtocolDraftView.title: ProtocolDraftView
ProtocolDraftView.description:
The Protocol Draft of a Review Package run: its Test Steps in draft order, its
traceability rows and its findings, each with its decision state.

ProtocolEvent.title: ProtocolEvent
ProtocolEvent.description: A status change of a Protocol: what, who, when and why.

ProtocolRowView.title: ProtocolRowView
ProtocolRowView.description: One requirement of the run and what the Protocol holds for it.

ProtocolView.title: ProtocolView
ProtocolView.description:
A Protocol assembled in TraceQ, for one Equipment, started from one imported run. Not
a Protocol Draft: that is the site's document under Pre-review.

Range.title: Range
Range.description: A required or tested range; either bound may be open.

RequiredDocument.title: RequiredDocument
RequiredDocument.description: A document the VMP requires for the Equipment, with the annex row cited.

RowDraft.title: RowDraft
RowDraft.description:
A drafted Test Step of the row's requirement, as the run drafted it, and the Proposal it
was imported as, decided with ``recordDecision`` (accepted or rejected).

RowTestStep.title: RowTestStep
RowTestStep.description: The one Test Step of a Test Step row.

RunPackage.title: RunPackage
RunPackage.description: The Review Package a run reviews and the Protocol Draft it read.

RunSummary.title: RunSummary
RunSummary.description: What identifies a run: its id, Equipment, model and mode.

SiteRuleCite.title: SiteRuleCite
SiteRuleCite.description: A site rule read from the SOP, with the sentence that sets it.

Source.title: Source
Source.description: A document and revision an AI Finding cites.

Tolerance.title: Tolerance
Tolerance.description: A nominal value with a tolerance: ``380 V ± 10 %``.

UnquotedText.title: UnquotedText
UnquotedText.description: URS text that no kept requirement quotes: adjacent lines merged.

UrsCompleteness.title: UrsCompleteness
UrsCompleteness.description: The completeness check of one URS the run read, built without an LLM.

VendorDocument.title: VendorDocument
VendorDocument.description: A vendor document of the Equipment the comparators of a requirement may come from.

VendorFactCite.title: VendorFactCite
VendorFactCite.description: A vendor step's observation or a design value, as printed, with its citation.
